reviews.excerpt: Booked Sureclean for a pre-move-in clean as we are doing minimal renovation and plan to stay in the unit while waiting for the works to complete. Honestly, this was one of the best decisions we made. The team arrived punctually, which was already a good start. There were four cleaners and they got straight to work. In about four to five hours, the entire unit was properly deep cleaned and genuinely spotless. This was not a surface wipe down. The previous owner left the unit as it was, so there was dust in all the usual forgotten areas where items used to sit. I did my own inspection after they left, checking the upper cabinets, racks, and hidden corners, and there was zero dust. Not almost clean and not just looking clean from a distance, but actually clean.

reviews.excerpt: I’m extremely satisfied with the cleaning service. I had a post-renovation cleaning done today, and the team was incredibly thorough and detail-oriented. They paid attention to areas that are often overlooked, and the difference before and after the cleaning was amazing. What impressed me the most was their attention to detail and professionalism. Even after they finished, they took the time to walk around with me and repeatedly checked if there was anything else I wanted them to look at or clean. They genuinely wanted to make sure everything was done to a high standard rather than simply finishing the job and leaving. I have quite high standards when it comes to cleanliness, and honestly, this is the first cleaning service I’ve used in Singapore that has exceeded my expectations. The whole experience was smooth, professional, and reassuring. I’m very happy with the results and would definitely use their service again. Highly recommended!
